symbols.name: chunk count bound
symbols.meaning: An upper bound on the number of equal-width address chunks whose selected bits one pass handles.
symbols.quote: Here the letter $d$ changes meaning: it bounds the number of equal-width address chunks that one pass handles.

relations.quote: The first tape procedure, [Address-field interchange](address-interchange.md), moves data between layouts by swapping two disjoint address fields of $u$ bits.
The second tape procedure does the butterfly part of each [transform round](transform-round.md) in one pass, applying the butterfly
